results.title: AUSTRIACARD Delivers First Jaywan Payment Cards for Wio Bank in the UAE
results.description: VIENNA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS has produced and delivered the first Jaywan payment cards for Wio Bank PJSC, supporting the continued expansion of the UAE's domestic card scheme and strengthening the country's payments infrastructure.
